decisions.text: CHARTER.md amendment, dated 2026-10-15: "Rules live in one AGENTS.md. init writes no CLAUDE.md except a one-line @AGENTS.md import when a CLAUDE.md, .claude/CLAUDE.md or CLAUDE.local.md in or above the repo would otherwise shadow it. Decided after verifying the Claude Code docs (AGENTS.md read natively since 2.1.277, all providers since 2.1.281)."

The runner's persisted --transcript-dir (an absolute local path in committed bundle state) is fixed in s1: the state keeps the run id only, the flag is dropped; after s1 lands the current runs are re-recorded without the path and the pre-fix state commits are rewritten before the branch is pushed (gate #0 on 06223a0 predates them and stays reachable). Logged as a backlog bug closed by this bundle.
The npm name cookwright is reserved by the developer now (a publish, their hands), before s1's docs land; the printed invocation stays npx cookwright.

doctor's git check when the config does not load: it judges the work tree only (PASS 'work tree; baseBranch unverified, config invalid' / FAIL not a work tree); the baseBranch half needs the config. Implemented in s2 with the §4.8 config-invalid cases.

The CHARTER amendment quoted in plan §2 says init writes CLAUDE.md only when a shadowing file exists; §4.4 step 4 also writes it when Claude Code is older than 2.1.281 (a version that ignores AGENTS.md). s3 surfaces the amendment wording to the developer in its strings batch before appending it; the developer's wording is final.

The leftover transcriptDir on plan-review run 0 was removed from state.json by hand (one key deleted, nothing else touched): the CLI refuses to re-record a done phase, so the re-record route of plan §2 (a) was not available. The pre-s1 state commits that still carry the path (d00d0bf, 3c39dc3, 09297eb) are rewritten before the branch is pushed, per the developer's decision.

probes.mjs (hasTool, claudeVersion, ignored, with tests) was not built in s1 because the recorded s1 scope predates the round-1 plan revision; s2 builds it as part of doctor (§4.8 probes, §4.4 step 6's ignored). levels.mjs holding only requires, with the level names and the no-next-level text in messages.levels / messages.noNextLevel, is accepted (it avoids a config → levels → messages → config cycle). The bundle CLI's other subcommands still ignoring unknown flags goes to the backlog in s3, beside E-004. The strings test of §4.9/§6 is s3's. The init/doctor placeholders are replaced by s3/s2.

Accepted as built: the loader's multi-line config message joined to one readout line; the 'cookwright doctor: ' prefix on the hook-mode counts line; weak and unverified appended to the level line with '; '; a check that throws is a FAIL row 'the check could not run'; --hook takes precedence over refusals (exit 0 always); rules.size measures every existing rules and shadowing file and is PASS with none. For s3: reuse hasImport (rules/block.mjs) and sessionStartCommands (doctor/claude.mjs) in init steps 4 and 5; write the block's prose in agents-block.md with RULES_VERSION staying 1; during the §7 dogfood add '!.env.example' to this repo's .gitignore so it matches what init writes, and set the README to say init and doctor exist. Backlog in s3: the hook command tests node_modules/cookwright under CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, so a Claude session started in a subdirectory of the repo, or a package installed in a workspace sub-package, prints 'package not installed' although doctor would find the root from there.

Accepted as built: the ignored probe uses git check-ignore --no-index (a tracked path would otherwise always read 'not ignored'); the .gitignore step may append a duplicate pattern line to keep the negation after the patterns; a fresh config writes every paths key as the plan says (Level 2 uses bundles and playbook; omitting them is E-007's question); init without git refuses with exit 2, since init is a command, not a check or hook. For fix:core: this repo's AGENTS.md has two '## State homes' headings (its own section and the managed block's); rename the repo's own section (e.g. '## State homes of this repo'), never the block's headings, which every user receives. The CHARTER.md amendment is appended in fix:core with the developer's final wording, asked after the review starts.

CHARTER.md amendment, final wording, to append under Amendments in fix:core: "2026-10-15. Rules live in one AGENTS.md. init writes no CLAUDE.md, except one that imports AGENTS.md (the single line @AGENTS.md) when Claude Code would otherwise not read AGENTS.md: a CLAUDE.md, .claude/CLAUDE.md or CLAUDE.local.md in or above the repo shadows it, or the installed Claude Code is older than 2.1.281. An existing root CLAUDE.md gets the import line prepended instead. Decided after verifying the Claude Code docs (AGENTS.md read natively since 2.1.277, all providers since 2.1.281)."

fix:core applies findings 0/6 (record session makes every files entry repo-relative and refuses an absolute one; the no-absolute-path test walks every file under the bundle directory), 2 (append the ignore patterns whenever a protected path is not ignored, even if listed earlier; second run idempotent), 3/11 (one shared 1.5 s timeout for every git call of doctor, init, probes and workTreeRoot), 7 (lstat in init and doctor; CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md resolving to the same real file is kept and host.rules PASS; any other symlinked target refused in preflight), 8 (append the charter amendment with the developer's final wording), 9 (validateConfig on a fresh config, refuse before any write), 10 (.gitkeep decided by git ls-files, not readdir), 12 (reword the settings note and README to 'other settings preserved (reformatted)'), plus the duplicate '## State homes' heading in this repo's AGENTS.md. Finding 1 is B-002, deferred by the plan: no change. Finding 4: the block's secrets line is reworded to 'Never write a plaintext env file (.env, .env.*) holding a real value, not even as a fallback'; the test fixtures keep writing env files in scratch repos with a value that is visibly a dummy (DUMMY=1), since the secrets check needs files to exist; the developer sees the reworded line in the strings batch. Finding 5 (npm name unpublished): the developer's publish is pending (ENEEDAUTH on the first attempt); the orchestrator verifies npm view cookwright before the branch lands and records the outcome; the invocation does not change. The history rewrite before push now covers every state commit written before fix:core's record-session fix, not only the pre-s1 three.

Accepted as built, over the earlier dispositions: tests write no env file at all (index entries and an injected root listing), so the block's secrets line keeps its stricter wording unchanged; doctor runs inside one 1.8 s total budget with a 1.5 s cap per call rather than a per-call timeout alone; .gitkeep is decided by git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard; the settings row says 'the other settings kept' with a layout suffix only when re-serialising changes the layout; the B-002 attempt (a31d247) stays reverted (1eb68ff), B-002 open. The six records committed before the scrub landed (three implement session reports, the three findings files) are scrubbed once in the working tree with the runner's own scrubLocalPaths and committed with this state; the history rewrite before push removes the paths from the earlier commits.

fix:whole applies findings 2/12 (refuse a write when any path component between the root and the target is a symlink, by comparing realpath(dirname) with the real root; README sentence made true), 3 (scrub structured values, not serialized text: walk the object and scrub each string before JSON.stringify, scrub raw text for .md; a local path is one under the repo root (made relative), the home dir, os.tmpdir(), <local path>, <local path>, /Volumes, <local path>, /home/*, or a Windows drive or UNC path; JSON.parse the result before any rename and refuse on failure), 6 (same fix), 8 (a left boundary before every machine-dir pattern; app<local path> and URLs untouched; tests), 5 (changelog and playbook join the overlap check: neither may equal or nest inside bundles, closeouts or backlog, nor equal each other; tests refuse before any write), 10 (a TimedOut check is SKIP 'unverified: <what> did not answer in time', never drift), 11 (hasImport accepts @./AGENTS.md as the same import). Finding 4 is B-002, deferred: no change. Findings 1/9 (npm name) stay the developer's landing precondition. Findings 0/7 (the history rewrite and the commit ids it changes) are decided by the developer before any rewrite; the plan's 'every recorded commit id survives' claim is corrected in the closeout, not in plan.md.
